steps.name: two-stage-commit
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/harness/test_execute_commit.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/harness/test_execute_commit.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 4
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/harness/

steps.name: branch-and-state-index
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/harness/test_execute_commit.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/harness/test_execute_commit.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 8
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/harness/
